name: transcription
description: Audio → text CLI: local whisper.cpp (Metal, :2022) by default — free, private, no upload cap; `--backend openai` is an explicit paid opt-in with a pre-call cost estimate, a per-run ceiling, and an audit line per request
hits: local whisper.cpp (Voice Mode :2022); OpenAI speech-to-text on opt-in
surface: CLI only. `run <file>` is local and free. `run --backend openai` sends the audio off-host and bills your OpenAI account: ffprobe duration → estimate → refused above `--max-usd` (default $1.00) without `--yes`; `--explain` prints the plan and calls nothing; every request appends a line to ~/.local/state/toolbelt/transcribe.log. No write to any shared system exists.

origin.note: hello-* workshop repo; the OpenAI backend, spend module, ceilings, audit line, tests and doctor checks were added in the belt. The upstream /transcribe skill file was not vendored — the router skill owns the entry point.

install.description: Create the in-project .venv and install httpx, typer, pydantic, pyyaml, rich (+ pytest) from poetry.lock
install.why: the `transcribe` console script and the tests import these; poetry.toml pins the venv to tools/transcription/.venv so nothing is installed globally
install.yes: .venv/ is created inside tools/transcription; no network call to whisper.cpp or OpenAI is made
install.no: skipped; `poetry run transcribe` fails on import until you run it

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Your own OpenAI API key; needed only for --backend openai. Alternatives, in the order the tool checks: macOS Keychain item with service OPENAI_API_KEY, then ~/.config/toolbelt/transcription.key (mode 600 enforced)

env.name: TRANSCRIBE_AUDIT_LOG
env.description: Override the audit log path (default ~/.local/state/toolbelt/transcribe.log); tests point it at a temp dir

auth.flow: None for the default local backend. For --backend openai: the operator's own OpenAI API key from $OPENAI_API_KEY, the Keychain item OPENAI_API_KEY, or a 600-mode key file; sent as a bearer header, never on argv, never printed or logged (the audit line carries last4 only)
auth.login: security add-generic-password -s OPENAI_API_KEY -a "$USER" -w   (prompts for the key; or export OPENAI_API_KEY)

caches.note: optional 600-mode key file, third in the lookup order; refused when group/world readable
caches.revoke: Delete the key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys; rm the file or `security delete-generic-password -s OPENAI_API_KEY`

safeguards: Local-first: with no flag the audio never leaves the machine — WhisperCppBackend posts to 127.0.0.1:2022 only; --backend openai is the single, explicit, loud opt-in to off-host egress and spend (SENSIBILITIES #1, #2 flag tier)

Pre-call cost estimate: spend.ffprobe_duration() reads the duration before any upload and spend.estimate_usd() prices it from RATES_USD_PER_MIN (dated RATES_AS_OF = 2026-08-22, source URL in spend.py); cli._prepare_openai() refuses with exit 2 when the estimate exceeds --max-usd (DEFAULT_MAX_USD = 1.00 in code) or when no duration could be read, unless --yes — which is always honored, because this is private spend (SENSIBILITIES #3, #5)

--explain pre-flight (cli._print_plan) prints endpoint, model, the exact form fields from OpenAIBackend.request_plan(), file bytes and duration, rate, estimate vs ceiling, key source with the header redacted, and the audit log path; it returns before any network code and writes no audit line (SENSIBILITIES #5)

Audit line on every request, both backends (spend.append_audit → ~/.local/state/toolbelt/transcribe.log, dir 700, file 600, append-only): timestamp | principal (key last4 or local) | endpoint | model | file name + sha256 + bytes + duration | usage from the response | billed_minutes | est_usd | x-request-id | chunk | status. `transcribe spend` and the doctor's checks/spend.mjs sum the month from it (SENSIBILITIES #7)

Key handling: spend.resolve_openai_key() checks $OPENAI_API_KEY, then the Keychain item OPENAI_API_KEY, then ~/.config/toolbelt/transcription.key and raises on a group/world-readable file; the key travels only in the Authorization header; no code path prints it and error bodies are truncated (SENSIBILITIES #6, #11)

Upload cap: a file over OPENAI_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (25 MB) is re-encoded once to 16 kHz mono 32 kbps mp3 (processors.ffmpeg.shrink_for_upload) and refused with the ffmpeg split command if still over — never silently split or truncated

Degraded mode is named: when :2022 is down the local path exits 1 and points at --backend openai as the paid alternative; `transcribe check` reports both backends and this month's estimated spend (SENSIBILITIES #8)
--paragraphs shells out to the operator's own `claude --print` with a text-only prompt and no permission bypass; transcript text is untrusted input and is never given a tool-capable session
Read-only toward every external system: the only mutations are the local audit log and the -o output file the operator named

verbs.name: run
verbs.note: default --backend local: POST to 127.0.0.1:2022, free, audio stays on the machine; writes only the -o file the operator named plus the audit line

verbs.name: run --backend openai
verbs.note: paid + off-host egress on the operator's own key: the flag itself is the opt-in; estimate shown; exit 2 above --max-usd (default $1.00) or with unknown duration unless --yes, which is always honored; audit line per request

verbs.name: run --paragraphs
verbs.note: spends the operator's Claude plan via the local `claude --print`; the flag is the opt-in; falls back to the raw text on failure

verbs.name: run --explain
verbs.note: pre-flight for either backend; no call, no audit line

verbs.name: check
verbs.note: GET :2022/health; key presence (never the value); month-to-date estimate from the log

verbs.name: spend
verbs.note: sums est_usd for openai lines in the audit log for one month

verbs.name: realtime / translations / batch
verbs.note: no code path to the Realtime WebSocket models, /v1/audio/translations, or the Batch API; file transcription only

risk.worst_case: one audio file's bytes uploaded to api.openai.com and up to --max-usd (default $1.00, raised only by an explicit flag) charged to the operator's own OpenAI account per run; nothing shared is written

checks.label: ffmpeg/ffprobe present (duration → cost estimate; re-encode over 25 MB)
checks.fix: brew install ffmpeg — without ffprobe the paid backend requires --yes on every run

checks.label: local whisper.cpp answering on :2022 (the free default)
checks.fix: mcp__voice-mode__service whisper start — or use --backend openai (paid)

checks.label: OpenAI key present in env, Keychain, or 600-mode key file (optional)
month-to-date OpenAI spend estimate from the audit log

smoke_test.command: TRANSCRIBE_AUDIT_LOG=/dev/null poetry run transcribe presets && TRANSCRIBE_AUDIT_LOG=/dev/null poetry run transcribe run tests/fixtures/silence-1s.wav --backend openai --explain && poetry run pytest -q
smoke_test.expect: presets render; the OpenAI --explain pre-flight prints the plan and estimate with the key redacted and makes no call; pytest green (ceilings, estimate, audit line format, key resolution, CLI gates) — no network, no credential
